message.content:
Christmas ornaments fall under HTSUS 9505.10 (festive articles, Christmas decorations). Subheading 9505.10.25 covers "Other" Christmas ornaments, not of glass: 9505.10.25.00 is "Other" (non-glass) Christmas ornaments, while 9505.10.15 is glass Christmas ornaments (a separate heading for "Glass"). The ornaments have a foam center covered in glass tiles, so the question is whether they count as "of glass."

For 9505.10.15, the product would be "Ornaments: of glass." Glass ornaments are typically blown glass. A foam ball covered with mirror tiles is not made of glass in the essential sense, since the foam is the main body. Prior CBP rulings classified similar mirror-tile balls under 9505.10.25 (other), and I'm fairly confident of that.

Subheading breakdown: 9505.10.10 is nativity scenes, 9505.10.15 is glass ornaments, 9505.10.25 is other, and 9505.10.35 is other. The 10-digit statistical suffix for 9505.10.25 is 00 (9505.10.25.00).
